BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to snack bar licenses; and amending RCW 66.24.350.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 66.24.350 and 1997 c 321 s 20 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There shall be a beer and wine retailer's license to be designatedas a snack bar license to sell beer by the opened bottle or can atretail and wine by the individual glass, for consumption upon thepremises in an area approved by the board only((,)). Such license tobe issued to places where the sale of beer and wine is not theprincipal business conducted; fee one hundred twentyfive dollars peryear.
